recipes.title: High-consequence action confirms by name
recipes.summary: Route the destructive action through the rounded confirm dialog: a sentence naming the object and the consequence, a deep-aubergine confirm pill, and an outline cancel. The destructive action is never the default.
constraints: the sentence names the object and the consequence
no default focus on the destructive pill

evidence.quote: Retire 'Cordless drill 18V' permanently? It will be removed from the register and cannot be restored. (approved screen)

recipes.title: Long-running work shows a rounded meter and a log
recipes.summary: Status pill plus rounded meter with an 'n of m' readout (orange while in flight), a restart action, and the event log as soft rows with muted timestamps.
needs: show the progress of a background job
constraints: state is always a word first

evidence.quote: 7 of 10 steps · reconciling loan dates… (approved screen)

recipes.title: Grouped form submission
recipes.summary: A surface of rounded fields and choices with labels above; actions row with an orange primary pill and an outline cancel; validation notes under the fields they concern.
constraints: one warm, plain error sentence per field
primary action is the orange pill; cancel is the outline pill
